# Cryogenic laboratory witness

This private F210 2.1.23 scenario depends on the unchanged `cryogenic-native` fixture. That companion selects `all-official` science, replaces the native cryogenic research trigger with a positive ordinary unit using a foreign resource-science item, and checks the affected MIR data-stage catalogue and native cryogenic gate.

The extra fixture checks all twelve official inputs and the cryogenic prerequisite before accelerating only MIR gear research to one unit and one second. It seeds the named other science prerequisites, earns the cryogenic owner in an actual lab using one foreign science item, then earns one MIR gear level using one nominal unit of each official science input, including freshness-sensitive agricultural science. It requires the native 10% gear bonus, zero laboratory productivity bonus and exact input consumption to survive a save and two cold reloads. Reload callbacks perform no repair or saved-state writes.

Agricultural science is intentionally not treated as an ordinary whole-item counter. Exact 2.1.23 Space Age source declares it spoilable after one hour (`space-age/prototypes/item.lua`); Factorio's official spoilage notes say its research value falls with freshness. The fixture requires that runtime prototype, a positive stale `spoil_percent`, the expected second item drawn, and partial `Lab::get_stored_durability` for the one-unit research. Its failure diagnostic records each input's inventory count, lab durability, freshness and spoil tick, so a changed engine accounting rule remains visible rather than being accepted as a different whole-item count.

The default gear effect is independently authored as `effect_percent = 10` in `research/historical_settings.lua`; `research/productivity.lua` converts it to `change = 0.10`. The fixture changes neither field. Run `40076699140` retained an incorrect 2% fixture oracle and failed before saving; preserve that adverse receipt. Failed bonus assertions now log the actual and expected recipe/laboratory values and native gear effect state. Correcting the expectation does not qualify a native retry until its gameplay, save and reload evidence passes.

Science inputs are supplied by the fixture; resource mining, science manufacturing, ordinary research tuning, arbitrary modpacks and the reporter's unknown exact configuration are outside this witness. Passing host controls checks the fixture's guards and registration, not native gameplay. The native worker must record the exact player, both fixture archives, observer, engine and profile and verify all artifact members before the result is accepted.
